taxi_search_regression.details: Search for 'Pris' returns 4 suggestions via /api/taxi/geocode. Search for 'Berlin' returns 6 suggestions. Autocomplete working correctly with debounce.

active_ride_live_movement.details: GET /api/taxi/rides/active returns ride with driver_lat=52.5202, driver_lng=13.4052, driver_bearing=211.32, driver_path with 3 points. All live movement data present for 'arriving' status.

active_ride_tracker_ui.details: ActiveRideTracker component renders with: status badge ('Fahrer kommt'), live movement banner, driver info (name, rating, vehicle), pickup/dropoff addresses, estimated price, Chat/Call/Share buttons.

ride_chat_functionality.details: GET /api/taxi/rides/{ride_id}/messages returns messages with role. POST /api/taxi/rides/{ride_id}/messages creates new message. Chat panel in UI shows messages and allows sending new ones.

api_endpoints_tested: GET /api/taxi/rides/active - 200 OK, returns ride with live movement data
